calendar.date_aging_limit: The accounting-period calculation is a necessary scheduling bound, not a guarantee that every later application date-window policy will pass. All real application period/date policies remain authoritative.
calendar.guard: Before launch, before every slot/call/native pair, and throughout running workers, require real UTC now + full declared 26 hours < period end; never manipulate any clock.
calendar.input_rule: Reuse exact October 1 qualification prompt bytes; do not recompute dates at B05 approval or launch.
calendar.launch_guard: Additionally require launch UTC + 52 hours < period end, so a full 26-hour campaign cannot encounter the rolling 26-hour guard cutoff.
calendar.note: Documents predate orders created during the later real-time measurement. October 1 scenario document/posting dates are intentional; order creation and any application default dates remain real time. Do not change prompt text, default-date semantics, or the judge to conceal this ordering.

cost_estimate.basis: API-equivalent planning estimate, not a Codex subscription invoice or a dollar spending cap.
limitations: 46 calls is an explicit planning assumption, not a measured forecast. Direct delivery changes the old call mix.
Observed per-call tokens and cache ratio may not recur. Calls/compiles/hours are hard limits; dollar estimates are not.
Cache-write, fast/service-tier, regional, tool or other fees are excluded; actual signed-in Codex billing is not inferred.
Local compilation/native execution has no separately metered cloud fee in this estimate; local electricity/hardware costs are excluded.

diagnostic.direct_delivery_condition: category candidate-runtime-exception AND thrown_by candidate; send unchanged closed bytes to the next builder invocation without analyst gate.
diagnostic.forbidden: No raw exception prose, database rows, private business answers, reference source, smoke tool, allocation teaching, support/model/public-tool changes.
diagnostic.legacy: Application-origin runtime and legacy categories retain analyst review.
diagnostic.support_or_outside: Send empty feedback and halt trial as equipment-suspect; operator review required, not automatic campaign void.
